title: Decomposing Functions into Given Building Blocks (Set II)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Using f(x) = x - 3, g(x) = sqrt(x), h(x) = x^3, and j(x) = 2x, express each of the following functions as a composition involving one or more of f, g, h, and j: (a) y = 2x - 3, (b) y = x^(3/2), (c) y = x^9, (d) y = x - 6, (e) y = 2*sqrt(x - 3), and (f) y = sqrt(x^3 - 3).
finalAnswer: \text{(a) } (f \circ j)(x),\quad \text{(b) } (h \circ g)(x),\quad \text{(c) } (h \circ h)(x),\quad \text{(d) } (f \circ f)(x),\quad \text{(e) } (j \circ g \circ f)(x),\quad \text{(f) } (g \circ f \circ h)(x)

steps.title: Decompose the Two-Step Expressions in Parts (a) and (b)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(a) } y &= 2x - 3 = j(x) - 3 = f(j(x)) = (f \circ j)(x) \\ \text{(b) } y &= x^{3/2} = (\sqrt{x})^3 = h(g(x)) = (h \circ g)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: In (a), multiply x by 2 using j, then subtract 3 using f. In (b), take the square root using g, then cube using h (or equivalently g(h(x)) on [0, infinity)).
steps.why: Tracking the sequence of arithmetic operations from x outward identifies the inner and outer functions.

steps.title: Decompose the Self-Compositions in Parts (c) and (d)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(c) } y &= x^9 = (x^3)^3 = h(h(x)) = (h \circ h)(x) \\ \text{(d) } y &= x - 6 = (x - 3) - 3 = f(f(x)) = (f \circ f)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: In (c), cubing a cube multiplies the exponents (3 * 3 = 9), giving h(h(x)). In (d), subtracting 3 twice in succession gives f(f(x)) = x - 6.
steps.why: Power-of-a-power rules and additive shifts correspond to self-composition of power and translation functions.

steps.title: Decompose the Three-Step Expressions in Parts (e) and (f)
steps.mathExpression: \begin{aligned} \text{(e) } y &= 2\sqrt{x - 3} = 2\sqrt{f(x)} = j(g(f(x))) = (j \circ g \circ f)(x) \\ \text{(f) } y &= \sqrt{x^3 - 3} = \sqrt{h(x) - 3} = g(f(h(x))) = (g \circ f \circ h)(x) \end{aligned}
steps.explanation: In (e), subtract 3 (f), take the square root (g), and multiply by 2 (j). In (f), cube x (h), subtract 3 (f), and take the square root (g).
steps.why: Three-stage compositions follow the exact inside-to-outside hierarchy of grouping symbols.
